extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors (especially users attempting to create a new article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural checks for contributors attempting to create a new Wikipedia page (here: 'Sigmund Freud jokes'), including account requirements, searching for existing content, redirects, and checking deletion or propagation issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for existing article or alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Sigmund Freud jokes" in existing articles. Please search for Sigmund Freud jokes in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, use the search box to look for exact matches and variant spellings or alternate titles so you don't duplicate content. The page explicitly advises checking alternative capitalizations/spellings and existing articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect incoming links to see whether the topic is discussed elsewhere or whether a redirect would be more appropriate than a new article. This helps identify existing coverage or context within Wikipedia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New or unregistered users cannot create articles directly. Ensure you meet the autoconfirmed status requirements (typically an account age and edit-count threshold) or collaborate with an experienced editor if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard, submit a draft, or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack permissions to create a live article, use the Article Wizard or submit a draft in your user space for review by experienced editors, or post a request at the Articles for Creation process or appropriate noticeboard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for recent-creation propagation delay and use purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you or someone else recently created the page but it's not visible, wait a short time for the database to update. Use the 'purge' action to force a refresh of the page cache.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log for removed pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the topic previously existed but was removed, consult the deletion log and deletion discussion to learn why (notability, sourcing, copyright, etc.) before attempting recreation; address the stated problems first.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization rules and consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm the correct capitalization and exact title form. If the canonical article uses a different capitalization or phrasing, create an appropriate redirect rather than duplicating content.
